title: QuakeWorld World Championships 2005
wikitext:
The '''QuakeWorld World Championships 2005''' was a national team [[:Category:Leagues|competition]] which had fifteen teams competing. Sadly, two teams had to give a walkover in the first round. First games were played in March [[2005]]. The tournament was never finished due to the QW.nu server crash.
